description: Lists an endpoint's audit and lifecycle events newest first. The feed combines endpoint changes with provisioning, scaling, readiness, rollout, and other events from deployments under the endpoint.

schema.description: Maximum number of events to return. Max 10000, defaults to 50.
Cursor from a previous endpoint event list response.
Event types to include, such as `deployment.scaled` or `condition.set`. Combined with other filters using AND.
Minimum severity. Omit to disable severity filtering.
Return only events at or after this time.
Return only events strictly before this time.

Deployment IDs whose events should be included. Every ID must belong to the endpoint. Supplying this filter excludes endpoint-scoped events unless `SOURCE_KIND_ENDPOINT` is also included in `sourceKinds`.
Resource kinds whose events should be included. Omit to include both endpoint- and deployment-scoped events.
ID of a subject associated with the event, such as a rollout. Combined with other filters using AND.

DE.ListEndpointEventsResponse.description: Endpoint and deployment lifecycle events, ordered newest first.

data.description: Events for the endpoint, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Null if there are no more results.

DE.EndpointEvent.description: One endpoint- or deployment-scoped entry in an endpoint's combined audit and lifecycle feed.

clusterId.description: ID of the cluster associated with a cluster-scoped event.

containerName.description: Stable public component label associated with a replica event, such as `engine`, `model-download`, or `sidecar`.

deploymentId.description: Output only. Deployment associated with the event when `sourceKind` is `SOURCE_KIND_DEPLOYMENT`.

endpointId.description: Output only. The endpoint this event belongs to. Always set.

logExcerpt.description: Short diagnostic log excerpt captured with a pod event, for example during a crash, out-of-memory termination, or image pull failure. This field is truncated and is not a streaming log API.

message.description: Output only. Human-readable description of the event. Short and stable; not structured data.

name.description: Resource name at the time of the event. Populated by: deployment.created, deployment.deleted, endpoint.created, endpoint.deleted

newReplicas.description: New replica count for a `deployment.scaled` event.

nodeId.description: Opaque node handle for correlating replica failures on the same node. Omitted when the replica is unscheduled or the node is unknown.

paths.description: Field-mask paths that were modified. Populated by: deployment.updated, endpoint.updated

reason.description: Stable condition reason, such as `AllReplicasReady`, `ReplicasProgressing`, or `ApplySuccessful`.

replicaId.description: Opaque replica identity associated with a `pod.*` event, stable for grouping events from the same replica.

serviceType.description: Deployment subservice associated with the event, such as `model-deployment` or `speculator-deployment`.

source.description: Output only. Service, cluster, or controller that emitted the event.

sourceKind.description: Output only. Whether this row describes the endpoint or one of its deployments.

status.description: Condition status for `condition.set` and `cluster_condition.set`: `True`, `False`, or `Unknown`. The condition type is carried in `subjectId`.

subjectId.description: Output only. ID of the event's subject, such as a rollout, shadow target, or condition type.

type.description: Output only. Stable event type, such as `endpoint.updated`, `deployment.created`, `deployment.scaled`, `condition.set`, or `pod.log`.

version.description: Target version. Populated by `target.created`; the target ID is carried in `subjectId`.
